body:
A Court-channel desk for The Squeeze, the El Segundo team in PTL Mixed 4.0, Fall 2026.

As transcribed from PTL screenshots dated about October 6, 2026: team rank #5, team DUPR 18.124, two matchups played. Season points 202 earned and 200 allowed, difference +2, PD% 0.5. Matchups 1–1. Matches 12–12. Games 12–12. Win rates 50.00% across matchups, matches, and games. Points earned 50.25%. Average opponent team rating 29.701.

September 16: Approach Pickleball (#2, away, PD% 9.09) 7, The Squeeze (#5, home, PD% -9.09) 5. September 30: The Squeeze (#5, away, PD% 10.61) 7, Beach Bangers (#4, home, PD% -10.61) 5. Those are team points. Line scores inside the matchups are not on the screenshots, so they are not here.

Still ahead, all 6:00 PM PDT at El Segundo Recreation Park Sports Courts: October 7, Carpe Dink'em (#6 away) at The Squeeze (#5 home); October 14, The Squeeze (#5 away) at Eleven MXD (#3 home); October 21, Dink Life (#1 away) at The Squeeze (#5 home); October 28, The Squeeze (#5 away) at Unforced Terrors (#7 home).

Mixed 4.0 points: Dink Life 28, Approach Pickleball 19, Eleven MXD 18, Beach Bangers 17, The Squeeze 12, Carpe Dink'em 11, Unforced Terrors 3. The standings screenshot cuts off after points per matchup, so last-match letters for the other clubs are left off.

The page names Michael Hoydich and Morgan Fukunaga Hoydich, his wife. Those names are the PointCast roster. The screenshots do not list players.

The page is /pickleball/the-squeeze/. The same desk as JSON is /pickleball/the-squeeze.json. PTL is the source. This is not an official PTL page. No affiliate, no monetization.
